overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that subtracting 5 years from a date using replace(year=end.year - 5) would always produce a valid date, without considering that February 29 only exists in leap years.
why_it_breaks: When end is February 29 of a leap year (e.g., 2024-02-29), subtracting 5 years produces 2019-02-29, but 2019 is not a leap year and has no February 29, causing Python's date.replace() to raise ValueError: day is out of range for month.
